subject: Pilot gate matrix & exec decision flow
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medivance.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medivance.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot gate matrix & exec decision flow

Hi Lena / Raj — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have aligned expectations coming out of discovery.

Summary of what we heard from your team:
- Goal: reduce triage time for clinical notes by surfacing relevant segments and suggested follow-ups (target: 45% reduction in manual triage time).
- Primary data: de-identified clinical notes + metadata fields (encounter id, clinician id).
- Success criteria: precision >= 0.78 on top-3 suggested segments; end-user time savings >= 30% in pilot user study; no PII leakage in outputs.

Proposed pilot (draft):
- Scope: 3-week pilot (minimum viable test) with a seeded evaluation set + 2-week sandbox for integration and validation.
- Evaluation plan: run daily automated metrics on seeded set; manual clinician review on a rolling sample (owner: Marissa); weekly checkpoint with engineering on integration blockers (owner: Sergio).
- Gate matrix (high level):
  * Gate 1 (Week 1): Data ingestion validated; KV cache working; baseline metrics collected.
  * Gate 2 (Week 2): Model precision threshold met on seeded set (>=0.72); UI integration hits minimal acceptance.
  * Gate 3 (Week 3): Final metrics meet success criteria and executive readout scheduled.
- Owners: Jordan (sales lead / exec scheduling), Marissa (CS & evaluation owner), Sergio (technical lead).

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Pilot window: Sep 14 — Oct 2 (3 weeks active evaluation).
- Exec readout / go-no-go: week of Oct 5 (30–45 minute slot for execs + procurement).

Next steps (please confirm by EOD):
1) Confirm success criteria above or list edits.
2) Share network / sample data access window for Sergio to validate ingestion (we can whiteboard specifics).
3) Confirm tradeoff on timeline — we can compress to start Sep 7 if you want an earlier readout.

Attaching a draft playbook and the acceptance matrix for your review. I can update based on your feedback and then Marissa will publish the evaluation task list.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193

Attachments:
- Medivance_Pilot_Playbook_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
- pilot-acceptance-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Subject: Re: Pilot gate matrix & exec decision flow

Jordan — thanks for the clear summary. A couple quick notes:
- The success criteria look right; can we add an operational SLA requirement (95th percentile inference latency < 350ms)?
- We have a constrained exec window on Oct 5; is there a way to compress the pilot by one week so the readout can happen Sep 28 instead? Our procurement team wants to close the commercial piece before Oct 10.

I'll loop procurement once we lock dates. Also copying Raj to confirm stakeholder availability.

Best,
Lena
Director of Product | Medivance

- Exec readout / go-no-go: Sep 28, 10:00–10:45 AM PT (we'll aim for a concise 30-minute review plus Q&A).
